assumptions: The Apex controller uses WITH USER_MODE for both queries to enforce sharing and field security.
Exception handling translates all query failures to safe AuraHandledException messages without exposing technical details.
The LWC component uses a request counter to prevent stale responses from overwriting current state.
The Jest tests use shadow DOM queries to inspect LWC template elements and mock Apex calls with virtual modules.
The permission set grants read-only access to both legacy and new Apex classes, preserving legacy Visualforce page access.
The package.xml includes all new and preserved legacy artifacts for dependency closure.

updates.content:
